candidates.title: [ux-sim] "Join Lumi" opens a "1 of 6" goals quiz instead of an e-mail field
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

All four first-open personas remarked on the 6-step setup; Jordan quit on its first screen. Aisha and Minji pushed through but used most of their patience; the communities step confused two of them (dorm chip has no dorm picker; "Membership is verified separately").

Severity **4** (Blocker — I could not continue, gave up, or would stop using the app here.) · analyst confidence high · **3 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Profiling before the account; "1 of 6" makes the length explicit right after the student chose to join.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261107-1915-jordan-first-open-decide` step 13 — “1 of 6?? i tapped join, not take a survey. six screens before i even see a person. nope” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/shots/013-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/shots/013-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261107-1915-minji-first-open-decide` step 13 — “1/6?? 6단계나… 아 귀찮아.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-minji-first-open-decide/shots/013-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-minji-first-open-decide/shots/013-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261107-1915-aisha-first-open-decide` step 43 — “Still no e-mail — this is a long sign-up. 'Membership is verified separately'… I don't be” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-aisha-first-open-decide/shots/043-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-aisha-first-open-decide/shots/043-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261107-1915-minji-first-open-decide` step 26 — “뭐지? 그냥 '기숙사' 체크만 됨. 내 기숙사는 어디서 고르는 거야?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-minji-first-open-decide/shots/026-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-minji-first-open-decide/shots/026-click-som.jpg)

Runs: [`sched-20261107-1915-jordan-first-open-decide`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/report.md), [`sched-20261107-1915-minji-first-open-decide`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-minji-first-open-decide/report.md), [`sched-20261107-1915-aisha-first-open-decide`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-aisha-first-open-decide/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `jordan-sophomore-impatient`, `aisha-firstgen-anxious`, `minji-freshman-17` · scenarios: `first-open-decide`

### Environment note

Same on live.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Account (school e-mail) first, then at most one goals screen; make the rest optional after entering the app.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).

candidates.title: [ux-sim] Guest club sheet repeats the one-line description and offers only "Follow"
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

All four personas opened a club in the new guest preview and found only the list description again plus Follow — no meeting time, open/apply status, members or events. Aisha worried Follow would look like rushing a fraternity.

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence high · **4 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Guest club sheet shows only list fields; imported clubs carry little more.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261107-1915-jordan-first-open-decide` step 9 — “that's it? same sentence again. no people, no next hackathon date, nothing.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/shots/009-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261107-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/shots/009-click-som.jpg)

candidates.title: [ux-sim] Guest Explore and first "For you" items are faculty talks and career fairs, not student life
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

First guest event was an emeriti speaker series for three personas; after sign-up Aisha and Minji (picked meet people/clubs) got career fairs and law events first.

Severity **2** (Moderate — slowed me down or made me hesitate; I recovered on my own.) · analyst confidence medium · **3 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).
